import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top products by revenue
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
axes[0, 0].barh(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top Products by Revenue', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(product_revenue.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v, i, f' ${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by customer age group
age_group_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('YlOrBr', len(age_group_sales))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 1].pie(age_group_sales.values, 
                                            labels=age_group_sales.index,
                                            autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                            colors=colors,
                                            startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Revenue Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)

# 3. Payment method usage and average transaction value
payment_stats = df.groupby('payment_method').agg({
    'total': ['count', 'mean']
}).reset_index()
payment_stats.columns = ['payment_method', 'count', 'avg_total']
payment_stats = payment_stats.sort_values('count', ascending=False)

x_pos = range(len(payment_stats))
ax3_1 = axes[1, 0]
ax3_2 = ax3_1.twinx()

bars = ax3_1.bar(x_pos, payment_stats['count'], alpha=0.7, color='#D2691E', label='Transaction Count')
line = ax3_2.plot(x_pos, payment_stats['avg_total'], 'o-', color='#8B0000', linewidth=2, 
                   markersize=8, label='Avg Transaction Value')

ax3_1.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11)
ax3_1.set_ylabel('Transaction Count', fontsize=11, color='#D2691E')
ax3_2.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, color='#8B0000')
ax3_1.set_title('Payment Methods: Volume vs Average Value', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3_1.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax3_1.set_xticklabels(payment_stats['payment_method'], rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3_1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#D2691E')
ax3_2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#8B0000')

lines1, labels1 = ax3_1.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax3_2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax3_1.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper right')

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in analysis by size
takeaway_size = df.groupby(['size', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
takeaway_size.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
takeaway_size = takeaway_size.reindex([s for s in size_order if s in takeaway_size.index])

takeaway_size.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 1], color=['#CD853F', '#A0522D'], width=0.7)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Revenue by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Service Type', frameon=True)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(axes[1, 1].get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
